# Retire compose error names across constants, language maps and localization together

The Bug 783526 continuation removes greeting, undefined-password, send-not-allowed, unknown-reason and CLIENTID error names from the compose error catalog. Each retired name is removed from the C++ constant definition, the JavaScript constant when present, both code-to-string maps, and its properties string. Entry 2090 also removes the password error from MessageSend’s hostname-formatting list. The historical maps keep sendFailed as the fallback, while current accepted JavaScript uses send-error-failed. A future catalog cleanup must inspect runtime producers, formatting branches, mapping tables and resources together. These diffs show coordinated removal; they do not independently prove a report about an unused producer or reveal reviewer reasoning. No send error, localization build, runtime or accessibility test ran. Full Bugzilla and review context remains pending.

Scope: Compose error catalog cleanup.
